title: SessionStorage via document.write
description: DOM-based XSS where a value read directly from sessionStorage is fed straight into document.write() with no intermediate function or wrapping.
objectives: Identify that the 'page' key is read from sessionStorage and passed to document.write() in a single line, with no processing in between.
Confirm that document.write() executes an injected <script> tag directly.
Note that this value only persists for the current tab's session, unlike the localStorage equivalent of this case.
hints: The value goes straight into document.write(raw) — no escaping, no function boundary to trace through.
Reset the state with sessionStorage.removeItem('page') or sessionStorage.clear().
